verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦੁ ਰਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੁਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras hoi bhavar lai vaas lubhaavai|

en.bdb: Like the bumblebee they surrender at the lotus feet of Guru and enjoy the sap and remain happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਲੰਘਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhamanaa la(n)gh tirabenee nij ghar aavai|

en.bdb: They go beyond the triveni of ira, pingala and susumna and stabilize in their own self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਣ ਲਿਵ ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸਾ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: saeh saeh man pavan liv soha(n) ha(n)saa japai japaavai|

en.bdb: They through the flame of breath, mind and the life force, recite and make others recite the soham and hans recitations (jap).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਮਚਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj roop anoop liv ga(n)dh suga(n)dh aves machaavai|

en.bdb: The form of surati is wonderfully fragrant and enrapturing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਸਾਗਰ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sukhasaagar charanaarabi(n)dh sukh sa(n)paT vich sahaj samaavai|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs calmly absorb in the pleasure-ocean of the Guru feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras dheh bidheh param padh paavai|

en.bdb: When they in the form of pleasure-fruit obtain the supreme joy, they go beyond the bondages of body and bodylessness and attain the highest station.
Such gurmukhs have the glimpse of that invisible Lord in the holy congregation.
